name_original: Lenovo - 11.6" Laptop - Intel Celeron - 2GB Memory - 32GB Solid State Drive - Silver
description_original: Lenovo Laptop: Work and play wherever you go with this lightweight 11.6" laptop. Check your e-mail and access social media with built-in wireless networking, and pair with your other devices via Bluetooth 4.0. Plus, connect an external high-definition display using the micro HDMI output.
